title: Consolidated model exception ledger
description: Every tested residual and documented special case, with its source table and full evidence. Repeated membership in different tests is retained, not counted as independent exceptions.

title: Editorial, formation and source decisions
description: Every research-only correction or explicit source observation, preserving its original locator and rationale.

title: All family-level open questions
description: The complete first-pass unresolved-issue register. An open verification question is not automatically a counterexample to a sound law.

title: Lexical class definitions and selection tables
description: All 27 class domains represented in the counterpart panels, with the frozen source inventory defining each. Overlapping subsets are not independent innovations.

title: Every tested class: all-language outcome ranges
description: Complete counterpart outcome sets in all seven languages. Broad family counterparts can have different formations; these counts are not cross-language prediction accuracies.

title: Every tested class: individual counterpart families
description: Exact selected class tokens are distinguished from every other record in the same research family. Unlinked members remain visible without invented cognates.

title: Every tested class: exact member tokens
description: The records that define each tested class; source constraints and split-token identity are retained.

title: Broad old-long falsification screen
description: All eligible old-long two-nucleus inputs with modern monosyllabic E/L readings. Family-level source and dialect conflicts remain conflicts.

title: Every broad old-long residual
description: Opposite or conflicting family/language cells, with individual explanations and unresolved issues.

title: Restricted nominal class: source and input sensitivity
description: 29 explicitly selected old nominal a-stem families; twelve input/source/lect scopes. This subset is not a claim of exhaustive nominal reconstruction.

title: Restricted nominal class: selection rationale
description: Every selected family, its independent nominal formation basis, and documented alternatives.

title: Restricted nominal class: all seven languages
description: Every selected family/language cell, including unmarked and excluded evidence.

title: Restricted nominal class: all residuals
description: Smell, village and source/lect/sense conflicts retained.

title: Short-root cluster comparisons
description: Old input and Shina lect outcomes. A descriptive structural screen, not a universal cluster-lengthening law.

title: Short-root cluster summary
description: Family outcome sets by old root vowel and Shina lect; vowels are not pooled.

title: Palula new short-a length: every pair
description: Biori short-a versus Ashret long-a; aspiration/h, forms, predictions and all residuals.

title: Palula short-a: units and scope
description: All forms, closed syllables, and closed lexemes with article/numeral identity collapsed.

title: Palula grammatical short-u class
description: Gender-inflecting regular/umlaut types, including accented ú and participles. Source metadata is not assumed to prove an exact dialect paradigm.

title: Palula POS-tagged short-u adjectives
description: Separate lexical-POS selection; all final-accented exceptions retained.

title: Gilgit short-o adjectives
description: Independent adjective tags and final short-o selection, with all unscorable records.

title: Adjective counterparts in all languages
description: Whole-family panel associated with source-tagged adjectives; includes other formations and senses, not one pooled adjective statistic.

title: Core property comparison: records
description: Predeclared property families, retained short endings and source-specific stress/accent position.

title: Core property comparison: seven-language counts
description: Penultimate, other, mixed and unscorable family outcomes. Restricted lexical comparison, not a fitted law.

title: Palula aa/ee+i noun paradigms
description: All 74 candidates, 73 comparable full-form cells/66 lexemes, and the excluded mismatched rainbow paradigm. Selection ignores accent.

title: Palula i-declension: extension beyond umlaut
description: All 43 further candidates, 42 comparable cells/30 lexemes. Final-i accent persists while citation E/L varies; the unverified gun variant paradigm is excluded.

title: Biori–Ashret raising: all 78 pairs
description: Quality, accent and syllable domain, including six aa-to-uu residuals and independently supported versus speculative proto-au analyses.

title: Vowel-raising outcome summary
description: Form-pair counts; two late-aa forms instantiate one accusative suffix, and five genitive forms instantiate one ending.

title: Kalkoti–Palula: every comparison
description: Source-specific tone/contour observations with formation exclusions, uncertainties and residual analysis.

title: Kalkoti–Palula: source-specific counts
description: 2013 phonetic contours and 2023 High/Low analysis kept separate.

title: Kalkoti–Palula: consolidated lexical cells
description: Cell consolidation by broad family and Palula citation; missing tone remains unknown.

title: Kalkoti–Palula: class counts
description: Known outcomes, Low interactions, unknown and excluded cells; not an unbiased sample of all tone categories.

title: Numerals 11–20: complete records
description: 381 source tokens across all seven languages, including different formations and misglossed twenty-plus-five expressions.

title: Numerals 11–20: seven-language panel
description: Ten-compound series11–18; nineteen and twenty compared separately. Not eight independent innovations.

title: Palula–Kalkoti numeral correspondence
description: Eight ten compounds plus two twenty-element controls, with predictions and all source outcomes.

title: Dras: every reviewed plural citation
description: 287 plural citations with singular candidates and individual or paradigm-class assessments. Exact-gloss matches are not automatically valid paradigms.

title: Dras: final-suffix accent readings
description: Every plural, including dual stem/final marks and source contradictions.

title: Dras: plural suffix counts
description: Final-only, dual, stem-only and unmarked citations. Counts are citations, not independent etyma.

title: Kundal Shahi: all 21 primary paradigms
description: Fixed, mobile rising, truncated feminine and unexplained postaccenting paradigms from the 2004 draft.

title: Sauji: all 573 Knobloch records
description: 335 manually reviewed gloss groups; linked, provisional, component-only and unknown analyses. Accent was not investigated by this source.

title: Full nearest-input class inventory
description: Seven-language outcome sets for every automatically described historical input class; overlapping family counts are explicit.

title: Full input classes: family/language cells
description: Complete eligible and excluded outcomes, with all forms and sources.

title: Frozen raw source coverage
description: Counts overlap for merged citations; accent-mark presence is not a phonological interpretation.

title: Research source coverage
description: Tokens, linked ancestry, unknown ancestry and explicit review counts after research-only corrections.
